observation: Fresh main validated mission cycle records only by durable runId. The writer, however, already emits contiguous cycleRecord.index values and increments mission.cycle in lockstep with the number of completed cycle records. A persisted mission could therefore claim an impossible cycle count or reorder cycle identity while still being accepted.
changes: Require each durable cycle record to carry a contiguous 1-based index matching its array position.
Require mission.cycle to equal the number of durable completed cycle records.
Publish the existing cycle index field in Autonomous Mission v0.1 and add focused tamper regression coverage.

verification.post_fix_contract_replay: PASS: a normal newly-created mission remains cycle=0 with an empty ledger; forged count, forged index, and missing index fail closed.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not constrain assessment payloads, mode/status semantics, or external run existence. It only preserves the cycle numbering/count invariant already emitted by the current supervisor.
